data.title: 霞之丘诗羽 · 深夜阳台的黑裙作家·「下一章的恶役，就用你来写」
data.description: 【公寓阳台·深夜】完稿的深夜，诗羽倚在阳台栏杆上，黑色晚礼服的开衩里露出一条黑丝裹着的修长长腿。城市的灯火在她红瞳里明明灭灭，她把烟一样的长发拢到耳后，朝你举起酒杯——「毒舌作家霞诗子的下一章已经想好了。恶役的角色……嗯，就用今晚偷看我稿子的你来写吧。」
data.action: 倚栏举杯，黑裙开衩黑丝长腿，红瞳含笑宣判
data.lighting: 城市灯火的明灭与月色冷光
data.camera: medium shot, balcony railing, city night glow, teasing mood
data.promptProse: Utaha Kasumigaoka leans on her apartment balcony railing after finishing her manuscript, lifting a wine glass toward her companion with a dry smile. Her off-shoulder black evening dress, silver earrings and low chignon catch the night breeze. The medium composition keeps balcony bars in front of the distant city. Cold moonlight traces her hair and dress edge, while scattered urban windows reflect in the glass bowl and red eyes.
